thread:
jules: Pushing a docs PR for a SUSE-focused on‑prem quickstart: includes PKCS#11 SoftHSM example, nftables rules, and a small troubleshooting note for the installer. Want eyes on the networking snippet and the HSM config before I merge.

samira: Nice! Can you add a short migration note for customers moving from iptables to nftables? A one-liner with link to our compatibility caveat should be enough.

naveen: I skimmed the nftables rules — minor nit: use explicit interface names rather than eth0 in examples. On SUSE the default can be ens192. Maybe show both a generic and a SUSE-specific variant.

jules: Good call. I'll include a generic block and then a SUSE example with ens* and mention systemd-networkd vs wicked.

luca: PKCS#11 sample looks good but add a SoftHSM slot mapping example and a minimal troubleshooting section if pkcs11-tool returns CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID. Typical fix is to export the token label in /etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf.

jules: Adding that. Also thinking to include this nftables snippet for SUSE minimal install:```nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
# allow loopback
nft add rule inet redwood input iif lo accept
# allow established
nft add rule inet redwood input ct state established,related accept
# allow ssh from mgmt net
nft add rule inet redwood input ip saddr 10.0.0.0/24 tcp dport 22 accept
# allow app ports
nft add rule inet redwood input tcp dport {80,443,8080} counter accept
# drop everything else
nft add rule inet redwood input counter drop```

samira: That snippet is great. Could we also include the equivalent nftables-save fragment so customers can persist it via systemd or Netfilter scripts?

jules: Yep, will add a short section showing nft list ruleset > /etc/nftables.conf and systemd service enable steps.

docbot: Link check: found a stale link to old HSM provisioning guide (docs/internal/old-hsm-setup). Suggest pointing to docs/security/hsm-provisioning instead.

luca: Also call out kernel module requirements for SUSE (e.g., ensure vhost_net and nf_conntrack are loaded) — some minimal appliances ship without nf_conntrack enabled and our installer healthcheck fails silently.

naveen: For the PKCS#11 snippet, include this small SoftHSM config example:```ini
# /etc/softhsm/softhsm2.conf
directories.tokendir = /var/lib/softhsm/tokens
objectstore.backend = file
log.level = INFO
```
and show the init token command:```bash
softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label "redwood-hsm" --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678
```

jules: Perfect — adding both. Anything else?

samira: One last doc-test: add a short checklist for air-gapped customers to ensure the SoftHSM package and nftables are present in the installer bundle. Maybe a two-line checklist so it's visible in the quickstart.

jules: Will do. I'll push an update in ~30min and tag you all. Thanks! :rocket:
